title: A service history ready for the sale of the car
description: The work, the readings and readable receipts come together in a chosen package for the buyer.

blocks.text: A folder of photos explains little without a link to a date and to the service. The owner needs an archive that still makes sense several years later.

quote.text: It’s handy to attach simple services you may perform on your vehicles to document maintenance history. Very simple to use. And a benefit if you’re ever planning on reselling your vehicle. Mechanic shops use it and you can to with everyday DIY maintenance to show a record of care.

blocks.text: Tie a document to the work and to the car. Before handing it over, build a preview of the selected records and keep a full private copy.
Check that the files are readable and leave out personal data that has nothing to do with the car. The log records documents; it does not confirm the quality of the repair.
